title: I worked on this sword-themed Card Game for almost a year, now on Google Play Store for Open Beta
author: Chocoweb88
selftext:
Hi everyone, I would like to share a trailer of my mobile card game:"5 Seconds Showdown", now available as Open beta on Google play store. No plans for pc or ios release for now.

https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.Chocoweb.FiveSecondsShowdown

I mostly use Claude to develop the game, and use Nano Banana Pro, GPT images, Gemini images, eleven labs and some music generation website to create the entire assets for the game.

This game still has lots of issues, and I would truly appreciate all honest feedback and criticism, so I can learn and grow better as a game lover.

I've explore this sub and learn a lot from you guys, and also gain alot of inspirations how to improve the game as well. My goal for this game is to try make something different, have a vibe and style of its own, and give players an enjoyable experience while they are in the game. 

Pardon my hopeless English because I tried my best to type without AI, let me know if anyone interested in the workflow (honestly, just the usual Claude prompting). Cheers and have a good day!
